description:
Import an ERC-8004 Identity Registry record (chain_id + ERC-721
    token_id + agentURI + owner). Idempotent: re-import updates in place.
    Returns the canonical record with its deterministic bridge DID
    (did:viridis:erc8004:<chain>:<token>).

agent_uri.description: The agentURI recorded on chain for this token.
agent_uri.title: Agent Uri

chain_id.description: EVM chain id where the ERC-8004 registry lives, for example 8453 for Base.
chain_id.title: Chain Id

metadata.description: Optional. Extra registration metadata to keep with the record.
metadata.title: Metadata

token_id.description: The agent's ERC-721 token id in the Identity Registry.
token_id.title: Token Id

name: import_registration
title: Import registration
